jobs.description: Warehouse Employee  Puttershoek  Introductie Looking for a rewarding career in logistics? Join Arvato in Puttershoek and become part of a modern warehouse operation supporting leading international brands. Work alongside a diverse team, develop your skills, and build a long-term future in a fast-growing logistics environment.  Wie zoeken we?  - Minimum A2 level English - Your own transportation and your own accommodation in the Netherlands nearby Puttershoek (within 30 km) - Flexibility to work in shifts - The ability to apply for a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) - Experience in logistics is a plus, but not required.  Wat bieden wij je? We offer: - Starting salary of €14.99 gross per hour - Growth based on performance - Shift allowances during peak periods - 25 vacation days and 8% holiday allowance - Mileage allowance - Work clothing and safety shoes - On-the-job training - Opportunity for a permanent contract - Career growth within Arvato Functieomschrijving As a Warehouse Employee, you play an important role in ensuring orders are processed correctly and delivered on time. Depending on business needs, you may support different areas within the warehouse. Your tasks include: - Collecting products and preparing orders - Inspecting, packing, and checking goods for shipment - Scanning items and handling returned products - Applying shipping labels and documentation - Preparing orders for dispatch to customers - Maintaining a clean, organised, and safe work environment - Working in a 2-shift system, with some departments temporarily moving to 3 shifts during peak periods

In this modern warehouse, you’ll work alongside your colleagues to ensure that goods arrive on time and in the right place. Thanks to the various departments, we’ll determine which tasks best match your experience, talents, and interests. This gives you the opportunity to do work that truly suits you.Your duties may include loading and unloading goods, picking orders with a scanner, inspecting products, and preparing orders for shipment. Together with your team, you’ll also help maintain a safe, clean, and organized work environment.Whether you already have experience as a warehouse associate or are looking to take the next step in logistics, you’ll receive excellent guidance and the opportunity to grow. Within this international organization, there are plenty of opportunities to learn new tasks.As a Logistics Associate, you’ll work Monday through Friday on a two-shift schedule. The early shift runs from 6:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m., and the late shift from 3:00 p.m. to midnight. Together with other warehouse associates, you’ll ensure that the logistics process runs smoothly every day.- You are available to work 40 hours per week- You have a good command of spoken and written English- You are willing to work two-shift schedules- You have your own transportation to the work location, such as a car, bicycle, or e-bike. It doesn’t matter whether you live in Venlo, Blerick, Tegelen, Sevenum, Horst, or Venray.- You can apply for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG). If the VOG is approved, Olympia will reimburse the cost of €41.35. If the VOG is not approved, you will be responsible for the costs- You work accurately and collaborate well with others

Candidates with relevant hands-on logistics experience are also welcome. - Commercial awarene...
